frase_gancho.texto: A white marble palace and the Alameda, the promenade where the city came out to stroll.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: The tour begins in the western part of the Historic Center, where the city opens into a park. The Alameda Central was planted in the late sixteenth century, at the initiative of Viceroy Luis de Velasco, so that residents would have a place to stroll among trees and fountains. Much later, the Palacio de Bellas Artes was built beside it, inaugurated in nineteen thirty-four. In this area you will visit seven stops: the palace and its museum, the park and its fountains, the Hemiciclo a Juárez, the Museo Mural Diego Rivera, and the Palacio Postal.
